description: Pointwise Wing penalty with a logarithmic region for absolute errors below width and a linear tail otherwise, following Feng et al., §4.2 Eq. (5). The summed default matches the coordinate and sample objective in §3 Eq. (2) and §4.1 Eq. (3). Clean-room implementation: src/topologies/implementations/losses/wing_loss.py:7-53.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(features[:2])}
dataset = synth.Spec("wing-regression", generator=samples, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "wing-loss", "loss_kwargs": {"width": 10.0, "epsilon": 2.0, "reduction": "sum"}}, batch_size=2, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a coordinate regressor with Wing loss

name: Wing loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts no additional parameters; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.epsilon: finite positive real number controlling the logarithmic curvature (default 2.0 from the CNN-6 setting in §4.2 and §7.1)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the regression formula defines no ignored target
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point prediction tensor with any shape
parameters.reduction: 'none' returns elementwise penalties, 'mean' averages all elements, or 'sum' totals all elements (default 'sum')
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor with the same shape and device as logits_or_prediction
parameters.width: finite nonnegative real number setting the logarithmic region threshold (default 10.0 from the CNN-6 setting in §4.2 and §7.1)
